desktop-agent/portal-hold.test.ts.overview: Verifies holdPortalBrowser and closePortalLoginBrowser manage the held supplier login browser purely through the SupplierBrowserApi adapter surface, using a synthetic fake browser.

desktop-agent/portal-login.test.ts.overview: Tests supplier session profile folders and saved-session markers, isPortalLoggedIn detection for Meesho and generic portals, and secretFromEnvironment credential resolution with alias precedence using synthetic environment values.

desktop-agent/src/browser-adapter.ts.overview: Supplier browser adapter that picks the external CDP-driven system Chromium (BrowserRunner) or the native Electron WebContentsView browser and exposes one SupplierBrowserApi surface to marketplace automation, failing loudly instead of silently substituting a profile.

desktop-agent/src/browser-flags.ts.overview: Pure Chromium sandbox policy that keeps the renderer sandbox on for untrusted supplier pages and emits --no-sandbox only when BROWSER_NO_SANDBOX is truthy or the engine runs as root on Linux.

desktop-agent/src/config.ts.overview: Loads and saves the desktop agent configuration (backend URL, API key, poll/heartbeat/follow-up intervals, browser mode and work directories) in the agent data dir, protecting the API key with local OS secret storage and only accepting trusted backend origins.

desktop-agent/src/cors.ts.overview: Exact-allowlist CORS policy for the engine HTTP API: only returnapp://desktop, the Vite dev origins in development, and normalized ENGINE_CORS_ORIGINS extras are allowed; the allow-origin is never '*' and never reflects an arbitrary origin.

desktop-agent/src/crash-guard.ts.overview: Process-level crash guards for the 24/7 engine: unhandled rejections are logged and filing continues, uncaught exceptions are logged synchronously and exit non-zero so the supervisor restarts a clean process, and EPIPE on stdout/stderr is ignored.

desktop-agent/src/evidence-files.ts.overview: Local evidence-file helpers backing the engine's GET /api/evidence routes: strict claim id validation, path-traversal-safe resolution inside the claim directory, file listing and content-type/disposition stream headers, all working while the backend is down.

desktop-agent/src/follow-up-bundle.ts.overview: Builds the minimal JobExecutionBundle for a follow-up ticket status check (no evidence, no credentials, placeholder claim fields) so the worker never invents a bundle at the call site.

desktop-agent/src/load-env.ts.overview: Side-effect module that loads .env files from the working directory and from AGENT_DATA_DIR for the desktop engine, while preserving process-environment precedence for the backend URL and the Meesho credential alias groups.

desktop-agent/src/local-secrets.ts.overview: Encrypts and decrypts desktop-agent secrets (operator session token, per-PC API key) with Electron safeStorage, i.e. DPAPI on Windows, and falls back to the legacy plaintext format when no OS credential store is available.

desktop-agent/src/logger.ts.overview: Engine-wide logger singleton that writes level-tagged lines to the console and to daily bot-YYYY-MM-DD.log files under the agent data directory (pruning old days), keeps a recent-log buffer and subscribers for the dashboard, and offers a synchronous fatal path for crash guards.

desktop-agent/src/marketplaces/ajio.ts.overview: Assisted Ajio supplier-portal claim automation that opens the returns portal, stops for CAPTCHA/2FA, captures prepare/submit screenshots, and hands filing back to the operator because no ticket number is read yet.

desktop-agent/src/marketplaces/amazon.ts.overview: Assisted Amazon Seller Central claim automation that opens the portal, stops for CAPTCHA/OTP challenges, captures screenshots, and asks the operator to finish filing since no case ID is captured.

desktop-agent/src/marketplaces/flipkart..overview: Assisted Flipkart seller-portal claim automation that navigates to returns, handles challenges and sign-in prompts, clicks Submit when allowed, and falls back to manual completion when no ticket number appears.

desktop-agent/src/marketplaces/myntra.ts.overview: Assisted Myntra partner-portal claim automation that opens the returns portal, stops for CAPTCHA/2FA, captures screenshots, and asks the operator to finish filing since no ticket number is read.

desktop-agent/src/native-browser-view.ts.overview: Native supplier browser for the desktop app built on Electron WebContentsView: gives each marketplace panel an isolated persistent partition, manages a tab registry with detach/dock windows, workspace-rect layout and focus discipline, and implements the SupplierBrowserApi used by marketplace automations.

desktop-agent/src/operator-session.ts.overview: Manages the desktop operator's backend sign-in: stores the bearer token encrypted in an owner-only session file, validates it against the backend profile endpoint, and provides authorized fetch, login and logout helpers.

desktop-agent/src/panel-queue.ts.overview: Panel-wise continuous claim queue that keeps in-memory runtime state per marketplace panel (busy, held, cooling down) and gives the worker a round-robin order so one stuck panel never blocks the others.

desktop-agent/src/portal-login.ts.overview: Supplier-portal login orchestration for the desktop engine: lists configured panel logins, resolves credentials from typed, admin, job-bundle or environment sources, opens the supplier browser to sign in, verifies the authenticated state, writes session markers, and requeues jobs.

desktop-agent/src/supplier-session.ts.overview: Shared supplier-session location helpers: per-account profile directories for the external adapter, separate native marker directories, and reading/writing the return-app-session.json signed-in marker.

desktop-agent/src/update-check.ts.overview: Check-and-notify desktop update module that compares the running app version with the newest desktop-v* GitHub release and selects the Windows NSIS setup asset; silent auto-install is deliberately not implemented.

desktop-agent/submit-guard.test.ts.overview: node:test suite for the pre-submit bundle gate, covering approval vs auto-submit accounts, stale or re-queued jobs, recorded outcomes, and fail-closed handling of unknown claim states.

desktop-agent/supplier-detach-window.tes.overview: node:test suite (VAL-WIN-001 to 004) for detaching supplier tabs into a hardened secondary window, re-docking, preserving sessions across window lifecycle events, and keeping background steps from stealing focus, using fake views and hosts.

desktop-agent/supplier-session.test.ts.overview: node:test suite verifying adapter-scoped supplier session directories (external profile vs native marker dir) and session-marker round-trips.

desktop-agent/supplier-view-manager.test.overview: node:test suite for the main-window supplier view manager, ensureSupplierView for manually opened tabs, native view ownership and adoption, and dashboard workspace-rect visibility rules.

desktop-agent/test-helpers/engine-boot.t.overview: Test-only boot script that starts the real desktop engine HTTP server and resumes the claim bot for the operator-login-flow test, printing ENGINE_READY; never used in production.

desktop-agent/update-check.test.ts.overview: node:test suite for the desktop update check: desktop-v tag comparison, update availability with a download link, Windows .exe asset selection, and fail-closed behavior when the feed is unreachable.

desktop/window-bounds.test.ts.overview: node:test suite for parsing persisted window bounds and clamping them onto connected displays, covering degenerate sizes, secondary monitors and off-screen fallbacks.

desktop/window-bounds.ts.overview: Pure, Electron-free window-bounds sanitizer that parses untrusted persisted geometry and clamps it to the window minimum and a connected display's work area, falling back to a centered default.

server/ai-memory.ts.overview: Pure rules for AI operational memory: normalizes worker error signatures, matches approved per-marketplace recovery procedures, and enforces the pending/approved/disabled status transitions that only operators apply.

server/tests/ai-memory.test.ts.overview: node:test suite for the AI memory rules: error-signature normalization, approved-procedure matching, status transitions and procedure usability checks.

server/ai-center-store.ts.overview: Additive PostgreSQL store for the AI Center that records and lists AI provider usage and agent runs, and adjusts confidence on approved memory procedures from verified outcomes without changing their status.

server/ai-memory-routes.ts.overview: Express routes for the AI memory and operator task center: admin CRUD and approval of recovery procedures, agent-facing procedure sync, AI Center usage and agent-run telemetry, and operator task listing, creation and resolution.

server/ai-memory-store.ts.overview: Authoritative PostgreSQL CRUD for AI recovery procedures, enforcing the pending-to-approved workflow, re-queuing edited procedures for re-approval, and serving only approved or disabled procedures to automation agents within their account scope.

server/analytics.ts.overview: Account-scoped return analytics computed from stored scans: size-, SKU-, marketplace-, date- and reason-wise figures, insight sentences and cards, and CSV export, shared by the Reports screen and the weekly email so both agree.

server/claims-routes.ts.overview: Express routes for the claims foundation: scoped claims queue and export, claim detail, creation and status changes, Meesho claim drafts, scan search, evidence media upload, streaming and deactivation via Firebase, and admin-only claim template management.

server/dashboard.ts.overview: Account-scoped dashboard, claims page and recent-return figures read from receipt_scans, expected_returns, claim_tickets and marketplaces, including headline counts, 7-day bars, reasons, SKU risk, warehouse operations and volume ratios in IST.

server/email-reports.ts.overview: Resend-based operational email reports with an idempotent scheduler: builds daily and weekly IST report data from PostgreSQL, renders HTML and text emails with analytics and Iron Send insights, and sends them to authorized Admin and Supervisor recipients under an advisory lock.

server/firebase-storage.ts.overview: Dependency-free Firebase/Google Cloud Storage client that loads service-account credentials, mints OAuth2 access tokens from a signed JWT, and uploads, downloads, deletes and lists objects via the GCS REST API.

server/format.ts.overview: Shared display formatting helpers for API routes and the return register: counts, percentages, IST scan and upload times, ISO timestamps, day labels and Indian Rupee amounts.

server/iron-routes.ts.overview: Express routes for Iron Send tracking (records, receive entries, batches, handover, downloads and pending clearing), the Iron overdue setting, return analytics reports with CSV export, and the live sync cursor endpoint.

server/iron.ts.overview: Iron Send tracking service: per-line records opened from scans, Inward Team receive entries, overdue rules, account-scoped listing and KPIs, numbered daily batches with handover workflow, and batch sheet exports as XLSX, CSV and a printable HTML slip.

server/meesho-claims.ts.overview: Meesho claim helpers: packet-state normalization, issue catalogue and TAT rules, IST date arithmetic for due dates, claim description text, and scoped draft and preparation of Meesho claims from a scan.

server/omsguru-daily.ts.overview: OMSGuru daily inventory update engine: aggregates good-condition returns per master product SKU for each IST day, builds the OMSGuru bulk adjustment CSV, uploads it to Firebase Storage with 180-day pruning, and emails it on schedule or on demand.

server/omsguru-routes.ts.overview: Express routes for OMSGuru daily inventory updates: configuration, today preview, unmapped SKU check, update history and CSV downloads, manual generation, email and WhatsApp dispatch, pruning, and WhatsApp settings, with Admin-only mutations and auditing.

server/operator-tasks.ts.overview: Operator task center store for the human side of the automation worker loop (missing evidence, approvals, rejections, expired sessions), with account-scoped creation, listing and resolution that keeps action history.

server/payment/db.ts.overview: Read-only connection layer for the external Payment/Sales database with strict TLS verification, a lazily created pool, guarded read-only queries, and a connectivity test.

server/payment/routes.ts.overview: Express routes for payment amount synchronization: sync status, connection test, recent sync runs, and manual sync trigger against the external payment database.

server/payment/sync.ts.overview: Synchronizes sale and order payment amounts from the external read-only Payment Database onto scanned return items (receipt_scan_items and expected_return_items) under a PostgreSQL advisory lock, and exposes sync status plus a once-a-day 04:30 IST scheduled run.

server/product-master-routes.ts.overview: Admin-only Express routes for the VB Exports product master: file preview, merge or replace import, batched staged import with progress, channel image inheritance, and unmapped listing SKU management, with every change audited.

server/reference-data.ts.overview: Idempotently seeds the marketplace channel reference rows at startup, adding any missing channel and never changing an existing row.

server/return-reasons-report.ts.overview: Builds the weekly return-reason and garment sizing intelligence digest, renders it as an executive HTML email separating seller mistakes from customer remorse and logistics, and sends it to authorized recipients via Resend.

server/return-reasons-routes.ts.overview: Express routes for return reason analytics (overview, seller-fault SKUs, garment size digest, canonical mappings) plus admin-only re-normalization sync and digest send triggers, with account scope on every query.

server/return-reasons.ts.overview: Return reason analytics engine that maps marketplace-specific return reasons (Myntra, Amazon, Meesho, Flipkart, Ajio) to canonical root causes, separates seller faults from customer remorse and logistics, extracts garment sizes, and serves scoped weekly summaries.

server/return-tracking-routes.ts.overview: Express routes for return tracking: account-scoped paginated listing with summary metrics, Myntra monthly returns CSV ingestion, physical reconciliation, and SPF claim filing from tracking rows, publishing live changes after writes.

server/return-tracking.ts.overview: Return tracking engine covering return lifecycle dates, Myntra Seller Protection Fund (SPF) Policy v5.1 claim aging and eligibility, Myntra returns CSV parsing and ingestion, scoped summaries and lists, scan-to-tracking reconciliation, and SPF claim filing.

server/scanner-list-routes.ts.overview: Express route that previews an uploaded scanner-list spreadsheet, matching each normalized AWB entry against the lookup data of the accounts in the user's scope.

server/scanner-list.ts.overview: Parses scanner-list XLSX workbooks into normalized AWB entries using Excel's displayed text, classifying each cell (valid, blank, numeric identifier, scientific notation, invalid format) and flagging duplicates.

server/scripts/create-user.ts.overview: CLI script (npm run user:create) that creates one sign-in user with a role and marketplace assignments, taking the password only from an environment variable and never printing it.

server/scripts/sync-payment-amounts.ts.overview: CLI entry point (npm run sync:payment) that runs the payment amount sync against the external Payment Database, with a --force flag to re-check already synced items.

server/scripts/sync-return-reasons.ts.overview: CLI entry point (npm run sync:reasons) that applies canonical return reason normalization and size extraction across stored returns and prints the weekly analytics.

server/scripts/sync-shopify.ts.overview: CLI entry point that initializes the database, checks the Shopify database connection, syncs Shopify returns into the register and prints the resulting metrics.

server/shopify/db.ts.overview: Read-only PostgreSQL connection management for the external Shopify database: verified-TLS connection settings that never leak the URL, a lazily created pool, a READ ONLY query helper, and a connection check.

server/shopify/routes.ts.overview: Express routes for the Shopify integration: connection status, manual sync trigger, account-scoped metrics, paginated records and CSV export.

server/shopify/service.ts.overview: Account-scoped query service for Shopify-sourced returns and RTOs: dashboard metrics, filtered paginated records and a formula-safe CSV export.

server/shopify/sync.ts.overview: Fetches returns and RTOs from the read-only external Shopify database and upserts them into the local expected-returns lookup data with master SKU resolution.

server/tests/access-db.test.ts.overview: Database-backed checks (run only with a dedicated TEST_DATABASE_URL) that account scope holds on lookups, scans, the register, exports and dashboard figures, using synthetic SYN- data per run.

server/tests/access.test.ts.overview: Database-free tests of account scope rules, the requireAdmin guard, ServiceError serialization, and safe register WHERE and sort clause building.

server/tests/ai-center-store.test.ts.overview: SQL-shape tests for the AI Center Postgres store using a fake pool: writes target additive tables only, confidence changes apply to approved rows only, list limits are capped, and the migration is additive.

server/tests/ai-memory-store.test.ts.overview: SQL-shape and transition tests for the AI memory procedure store using a fake pool: status and marketplace filtering, scoped sync, pending creation, approve/disable transitions and row mapping.

server/tests/auth-persistent.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for persistent authentication: token generation and hashing, device naming, session cookie flags, Admin/Supervisor role guards, CSRF origin checks and the brute-force rate limiter.

server/tests/claim-authorization-db.test.overview: Real-PostgreSQL checks for M9 claim submission authorization: a worker holding a saved supplier login cannot record a ticket on an approval-required account, while the approved lease path records a ticket once and idempotently.

server/tests/claim-automation.test.ts.overview: Unit tests for claim automation: credential encryption and masking, agent authentication, marketplace evidence rules, job stage transitions, lease-guarded progress reporting, error serialization and desktop agent config defaults.

server/tests/claim-evidence-gate.test.ts.overview: Unit tests for the claim-automation evidence gate: verifies pollNextAutomationJob leases only claims in the explicit eligible states (ready_for_claim, processing, reclaim, escalated) using a fake pg pool that captures SQL.

server/tests/claim-follow-up.test.ts.overview: Pure unit tests (35 cases, fake DB) for the claim ticket follow-up rules: two-day cadence, portal ticket-text normalization, terminal states, claim-status mapping, check budget and error-streak stops, and leasing/rescheduling behaviour of claim-follow-up-service.

server/tests/claim-idempotency-m8.test.t.overview: Regression tests for M8 claim-submission idempotency and authorization: ticket replay and overwrite guards on completeJobSubmission, retry/approve refusals once a claim has an outcome, lease ownership and expiry checks, row-locked lease serialization, and register ticket-replacement history.

server/tests/claims.test.ts.overview: Unit tests for claims-service validation rules (lifecycle statuses, transitions, field/template/evidence validators, retention and max-length constants) plus Meesho claim helpers such as TAT due date, packet-state normalization and claim description text.

server/tests/continuous-scanning.test.ts.overview: Scenario tests for continuous barcode scanning: ten warehouse flows covering clear/issue saves, failed saves, duplicates, FIFO buffering of barcodes that arrive mid-verification or mid-save, 100+ consecutive scans, and hardware-scanner burst detection, built on validateScanSubmission and decideLookup.

server/tests/database-ssl.test.ts.overview: Safety tests for the database layer: connectionSettingsFor keeps TLS certificate verification on (refusing sslmode=no-verify and malformed URLs), and static scans of the server schema SQL and service code assert there is no DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE of history tables and that foreign keys reference real tables.

server/tests/device-sessions.test.ts.overview: Unit tests for device-session auth helpers: token generation entropy, SHA-256 token hashing, user-agent device-name parsing, cookie parsing, and the default session configuration.

server/tests/email-reports.test.ts.overview: Unit tests for the email reporting module: IST date-part calculation, daily and weekly HTML/plain-text email rendering, Resend dry-run behaviour when no API key is configured, and the sender address constant.

server/tests/flyer.test.ts.overview: Unit tests for the Meesho flyer rules in register-rules: only the Meesho account takes a flyer, scientific/short IDs are refused, issue returns need a decision, and flyers are never stored outside a Meesho issue return.

server/tests/format-unmapped.test.ts.overview: Regression tests for upload timestamp formatting: shows formatUploadLabel loses the year when re-parsed, and that toIsoTimestamp round-trips the true date, never fabricates dates from NULL input, and renders correctly as IST on the client.

server/tests/iron-db.test.ts.overview: Real-database integration tests (require TEST_DATABASE_URL) for Iron Send: clear-return classification, Inward-Team-only receiving, pending/received/overdue quantities, batches and handover, OMSGuru exclusion, analytics and email report queries against the real schema, and live sync cursor movement.

server/tests/iron.test.ts.overview: Pure unit tests for Iron Send rules and related helpers: Iron Send never makes a scan an issue return, receive permissions and quantity checks, batch numbering and khaata/return-desk routing, analytics filters and insights, live-change visibility, volume ratios, and placeholder master-SKU handling.

server/tests/marketplace-ingestion.test..overview: Synthetic ingestion tests for marketplace return reports: Myntra, Ajio, Flipkart and Meesho layouts parse via parseSpreadsheet, identifiers keep leading zeros, headers are resilient to reordering, missing headers fail safely, client scan keys validate, and a 2,500-SKU performance check runs.

server/tests/meesho-claim-issues.test.ts.overview: Unit tests for prepareMeeshoClaim issue-code handling: unknown Meesho issue codes are rejected, an empty code keeps the scan-derived fallback, and mapped codes resolve with an explicit or Unknown packet state.

server/tests/mobile-app.test.ts.overview: Tests for the mobile scanner contract: the release manifest from getMobileReleaseInfo, the register-routes submissionFrom parser preserving exact tracking strings, multi-product parcels, refusal of legacy uppercase codes, missing-unit coverage, and tracking normalization.

server/tests/omsguru-daily.test.ts.overview: Unit tests for the OMSGuru daily inventory update: request ID format, bulk-inventory CSV headers and escaping, email rendering, default 23:58 IST schedule, cross-marketplace SKU aggregation that excludes issue returns, time normalization, and the Firebase configuration check.

server/tests/operator-tasks.test.ts.overview: Unit tests (fake DB) for operator tasks: creation validates kind and title, checks claim scope and writes history; listing filters by marketplace scope and status; resolving requires a note, an open task and scope, then stamps the resolution.

server/tests/payment-sync.test.ts.overview: Tests for the payment database sync: the read-only query guard rejects destructive SQL, connection settings enforce TLS, the register Amount column maps sales_amount, sync status metrics, and the 04:30 IST scheduler skip rules.

server/tests/register-db.test.ts.overview: Real-database integration tests (require TEST_DATABASE_URL) for the return scan register: per-account AWB isolation, idempotent and concurrent scan saves, missing-unit sub-issues and tickets, ticket history, lookup activation and rollback, register listing/export, and persistence across schema re-runs.

server/tests/register-rules.test.ts.overview: Comprehensive unit tests (41 cases) for register-rules: scan key and tracking normalization, lookup decisions across accounts, scan submission validation (lines, quantities, missing-item sub-issues, tickets, categories), issue descriptions, ticket status rules, and register CSV mapping.

server/tests/return-reasons.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for return-reason normalization: garment size extraction from listing SKUs, per-marketplace mapping of Myntra, Amazon, Meesho, Flipkart and Ajio reasons to canonical categories, and the weekly reasons email rendering.

server/tests/return-tracking.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for return tracking: return date selection for customer returns vs RTO, day differences, claim aging buckets (transit, eligible, expiring, expired, delivered), Myntra returns CSV parsing, and empty-scope summary/list results.

server/tests/scanner-list.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for parseScannerList: worksheet and source coordinates are preserved, numeric/scientific identifiers are never used as lookup keys, and repeated AWBs across worksheets are flagged.

server/tests/security-operations.test.ts.overview: Security and operations checks: RateLimiter lockout and reset behaviour, production error messages that never leak stack traces or database errors, and presence of performance indexes in the register schema SQL.

server/tests/shopify-sync.test.ts.overview: Tests for the Shopify read-only integration: destructive-SQL guard, Created minus Received equals Pending formula, account-scope enforcement on metrics and records, Returns/RTO breakdowns, CSV export quoting, and TLS/CA connection settings.

server/tests/unmapped-skus.test.ts.overview: Single unit test confirming matchedFieldFor matches Amazon Order IDs with or without hyphens.

server/tests/whatsapp.test.ts.overview: Tests for the WhatsApp gateway: default config values, OMSGuru caption rendering with mentions, graceful skip when disabled, retry-and-recover on HTTP 500 and transient network errors for text and document sends, and zero/negative filtering in the OMSGuru CSV.

server/whatsapp.ts.overview: WhatsApp gateway client for a self-hosted GOWA service: loads and saves its config in app_system_settings with audit logging, checks connection status, sends text and document messages with retry/backoff, and dispatches the OMSGuru daily inventory CSV and daily returns briefing to a group.

desktop/renderer/src/app.component.test..overview: Component tests for the desktop renderer shell (node:test, Testing Library, happy-dom) that drive the real App against a stubbed global fetch, covering the offline connecting state, the login gate, seven-tab hash navigation, the MarketplaceBadge logo fallback and Modal focus handling.

desktop/renderer/src/components/SystemSt.overview: Top-bar pill that polls the Electron shell every 5 seconds for CPU/RAM stats and renders a formatted label with a tooltip; renders nothing when the desktop bridge is absent.

desktop/renderer/src/components/UpdateDo.overview: Shared download-update control for the app banner and the Updates page, rendering idle, downloading-with-progress, done (double-click-confirmed Run installer) and inline error-with-retry states driven by useUpdateDownload.

desktop/renderer/src/components/system-s.overview: node:test unit tests for the system-stats formatters: the CPU/RAM pill label, the tooltip content and compact uptime rendering.
Pure formatters that turn shell system-stats snapshots into the top-bar label (one-decimal CPU, whole MB), a tooltip (process count, RAM share, uptime) and compact days/hours/minutes uptime text.

desktop/renderer/src/components/ui/Badge.overview: Small pill Badge component with six color variants (neutral, green, orange, purple, blue, red) used for statuses across the renderer; also exports the BadgeVariant type.

desktop/renderer/src/components/ui/DataT.overview: Generic accessible data table with declarative typed columns, optional cell renderers and stable row keys across polls, rendering an EmptyState when there are no rows.

desktop/renderer/src/components/ui/Empty.overview: Placeholder component that shows a title and optional message when a list or table has nothing to display.

desktop/renderer/src/components/ui/Error.overview: Alert-role error panel component with a title, optional message and optional Retry button.

desktop/renderer/src/components/ui/Marke.overview: Marketplace identity badge that maps marketplace names (Meesho, Flipkart, Amazon, Myntra VB/EJ, Ajio) to bundled /logos images and falls back to a colored letter avatar when the image fails to load.

desktop/renderer/src/components/ui/Modal.overview: Accessible dialog component (role=dialog, aria-modal) with focus trapping, Escape and close-button dismissal, and focus restoration to the previously focused element.

desktop/renderer/src/components/ui/Panel.overview: Colored status dot and label for a supplier panel's runtime state (idle, preparing, submitting, prepared, manual action, cooldown, disabled); also exports the PANEL_STATE_LABELS map.

desktop/renderer/src/components/ui/Spinn.overview: Minimal animated loading spinner component used across pages and the shell.

desktop/renderer/src/components/ui/StatC.overview: KPI card component showing a label, value, optional hint and icon, used for the dashboard job counters.

desktop/renderer/src/hooks/useBrowserWor.overview: React hook that reports a placeholder element's bounding rect to the Electron shell (ResizeObserver plus throttled resize/scroll) so the native supplier WebContentsView fills exactly that area, sending null when inactive or unmounted.

desktop/renderer/src/hooks/useEnginePoll.overview: Generic serial polling hook that runs an engine API call immediately and then every interval while enabled, returning the latest data and EngineApiError and routing auth failures to the session.

desktop/renderer/src/hooks/useEngineStat.overview: Hook that polls GET /api/status on an interval, exposing the status snapshot, the last error and a refresh() that restarts the poll immediately after worker-changing actions.

desktop/renderer/src/hooks/useUpdateDown.overview: Hook that owns the update-installer download state machine (idle, downloading, done, launching, error) over the desktop bridge, with streamed progress, retry and a double-click-armed installer launch; also exports byte and progress formatters.

desktop/renderer/src/main.tsx.overview: Renderer entry point that applies the persisted theme before first paint, loads global styles and mounts App inside StrictMode, ThemeProvider and SessionProvider.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/AiCenter.tsx.overview: AI Center page with five locally switched sub-tabs (Providers, Routing, Agents, Usage & Costs, Learning & Memory); every panel stays mounted but polls the engine only while its sub-tab is active.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/Browsers.test.overview: Unit tests for the Browsers page's pure helpers: open/closed tab filtering, the active-tab resolution fallback chain and plain-text URL pill formatting.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/Browsers.tsx.overview: Supplier browsers page that hosts the six marketplace panels as native browser tabs: tab strip, navigation toolbar, fullscreen mode, detach/dock/focus/hide controls and a bounded viewport the Electron shell fills, with every action calling the engine's /api/portal-browser routes and applying the returned snapshot.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/Claims.test.t.overview: Unit tests for the Claims page helpers: pipeline-stage bucketing, job search filtering, evidence payload normalization, evidence file kind detection and byte formatting.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/Claims.tsx.overview: Claims page that lists automation jobs with search, stage filter chips and a detail view of logs and on-disk evidence (photos and videos), plus run-one, panel clear/rejoin and login-setup actions against the engine's /api/jobs, /api/panels and /api/evidence routes.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/Dashboard.tes.overview: Unit tests for dashboard-logic: job-stage counting, the overall "All panels green" / "Action required" derivation, per-panel chips, engine and log time formatting, and log level normalization.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/FollowUps.tes.overview: Unit tests for the FollowUps page's whenText relative-time formatter and followUpStateLabel cadence and stop-reason labels.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/FollowUps.tsx.overview: Ticket follow-ups page of the desktop renderer: polls GET /api/follow-ups every 60s and lists each filed claim's marketplace ticket, check cadence, last/next check times and stop reason in a DataTable with a retry-able error state.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/Settings.inte.overview: node:test + Testing Library interaction tests for the Settings supplier-login disclosure; stubs global fetch under happy-dom to verify the form stays hidden when all panels are connected, reveals and focuses on demand, and auto-opens without stealing focus.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/Settings.test.overview: Unit tests for the Settings page pure helpers (marketplace-to-panel-key mapping, channel status and ping labels, the MARKETPLACES list) plus an SSR smoke render of SettingsPage via renderToString without an engine or DOM.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/Settings.tsx.overview: Desktop Settings page: onboards the six supplier panels (login status polling, credential save and test), edits and pings the backend server URL, shows security and app info, and shows/hides the embedded supplier browser through engine API calls.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/Updates.test..overview: node:test suite for the Updates page helpers covering auto-update preference persistence, last-checked timestamp storage, update-result classification and Windows setup-asset picking, using in-memory and throwing Storage fakes.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/Updates.tsx.overview: Updates page that shows the installed desktop version, runs manual checks against GET /api/updates/check, persists the auto-check preference and last-checked time in localStorage, and hands an available installer to UpdateDownloadFlow.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/ai-center/Age.overview: AI Center Agents sub-tab: a read-only ledger of the last 100 real worker AI executions with approval-state badges, polled through useTabData from /api/v1/ai-center/activity.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/ai-center/Mem.overview: AI Center Learning & Memory sub-tab listing locally mirrored approved recovery procedures and the AI usage ledger, with a confirm-guarded local kill-switch that disables a procedure via POST /api/v1/ai-memory/disable.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/ai-center/Pro.overview: Modal editor for one AI provider's API key and default model: stores the key via POST .../key without ever rendering it, discovers models, saves the default model and runs a low-cost connection test reporting latency and token usage.
AI Center Providers sub-tab listing each catalog provider's key status, default model and last success/error, with row actions that open the key editor modal or remove a stored key via DELETE.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/ai-center/Rou.overview: AI Center Routing sub-tab showing the per-task model routing table and a monthly USD budget editor that round-trips the full routing object to POST /api/v1/ai-center/routing.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/ai-center/Usa.overview: AI Center Usage & Costs sub-tab with a bolded summary line, the last 200 usage records and validated plain-text YYYY-MM-DD date filters that refetch /api/v1/ai-center/usage.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/ai-center/con.overview: Shared AI Center UI primitives: Tailwind button/input class constants plus the InlineMessage, ActionAlert, Modal-based ConfirmDialog and Segments components used by every sub-tab.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/ai-center/for.overview: node:test suite for the AI Center format helpers: USD/count/date formatting, truncation, timeout labels, YYYY-MM-DD validation, usage summary segments, memory status metadata and error-message extraction.

Pure, DOM-free display helpers shared by the five AI Center panels: en-IN date, USD and count formatting, truncation, YYYY-MM-DD range validation, usage summary segments, memory status metadata and error-message extraction.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/ai-center/use.overview: Generic React hook for AI Center sub-tabs that fetches immediately while the panel is active, polls serially every 60s, and exposes data, an EngineApiError and a manual refresh().

desktop/renderer/src/pages/dashboard/das.overview: Pure dashboard derivations mirroring the legacy engine dashboard: job-stage KPI counts, the "All panels green" / "Action required" headline, per-panel status chips, and engine/log time and level formatters.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/dashboard/use.overview: React hook that tails the engine's live log over Server-Sent Events (GET /api/logs/stream), keeps the newest N entries, and reconnects with bounded retries before reporting an unavailable status.

desktop/renderer/src/pages/follow-ups-no.overview: node:test suite for detectFollowUpNotifications covering first-batch tracking-started alerts, approved/paid/rejected transitions, Meesho response-wording detection and stable dedupe keys.

Pure diff over consecutive /api/follow-ups snapshots producing OS notifications for ticket tracking started, claim approved or paid, claim rejected and Meesho needs-response, each with a stable dedupe key that App.tsx tracks.

desktop/renderer/src/services/config.ts.overview: Thin barrel that re-exports the engine API client surface (resolveEngineBase as getEngineBase, error class and guards, apiGet/apiPost/apiDelete) so pages can import it from one place.

desktop/renderer/src/services/engineApi..overview: Unit tests for EngineApiError construction and the isSessionError (HTTP 401) and isNetworkError (status 0) type guards, including rejection of foreign and fetch-shaped errors.

desktop/renderer/src/state/SessionContex.overview: React context holding the signed-in operator profile and a monotonic session epoch; handleAuthError clears the session on engine 401s. Exposes SessionProvider and useSession.

desktop/renderer/src/state/ThemeProvider.overview: Light/dark theme context that applies the persisted data-theme attribute before first paint, keeps it in sync with localStorage, and exposes useTheme with a toggle.

desktop/renderer/src/types/engine.ts.overview: Engine API DTO type definitions (status snapshots, jobs, follow-ups, panels, portal logins, update checks, browser tabs, log events, and AI Center providers/routing/usage/activity/memory) matching the desktop-agent wire format.

desktop/renderer/test-setup/register-dom.overview: Test bootstrap that idempotently registers happy-dom globals and a React global for node:test runs of the desktop renderer, so React 19 createRoot and Testing Library find window/document at import time.

desktop-agent/ai-assistant.test.ts.overview: node:test suite for the local AI assistance core: verifies AI stays off until opted in, gateway config is mandatory, proposals are allowlist- and ticket-validated, retries are bounded, and follow-up routing is memory-first.

desktop-agent/ai-center-assist.test.ts.overview: Scenario tests for AI Center routed assistance: unchanged statuses need no model, provider outages degrade to human review with an operator task, monthly budgets block AI calls, and missing token counts stay Unknown cost.

desktop-agent/ai-center.test.ts.overview: Broad AI Center integration test suite covering the cost-aware router, durable usage ledger, routing/activity store, Firebase signal fail-open, AI SDK bridge model construction, provider key store, test-model resolution, and prompt-injection resistance.

desktop-agent/ai-memory-cache.test.ts.overview: Tests the engine-local AI memory cache: corrupt files load empty, approved procedures round-trip, pending/disabled mirrors never match, events are capped and pruned after 24h, and sync staleness honours the TTL.

desktop-agent/ai-memory-panel.test.ts.overview: Tests the AI memory dashboard payload builder: HTML markup in procedure fields is escaped, recent events are capped at 20, and the local disable kill-switch reports found/changed correctly.

desktop-agent/ai-providers-live.test.ts.overview: Opt-in live provider checks that make one real low-token testConnection call per provider only when the matching API key env var is set, otherwise reporting NOT EXECUTED without network access.

desktop-agent/ai-providers.test.ts.overview: Mock-fetch test suite for the AI provider catalog and adapters: catalog versioning, HTTP error classification, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini transport parsing, structured output validation, timeouts, retries, fallback, cost estimation, and model discovery.

desktop-agent/html-escape.test.ts.overview: Unit tests for HTML entity escaping and inline-script-safe JavaScript literals, including script-element breakout attempts and Unicode line separators.

desktop-agent/paths.test.ts.overview: Tests engine data-path resolution and secret-file writing: AGENT_DATA_DIR override, home-folder fallback, subfolder joins, and POSIX 0700/0600 permission tightening of loose roots and secrets.

desktop-agent/src/ai-assistant.ts.overview: Provider-independent local AI orchestration core for the automation engine: loads opt-in gateway config, provides the authenticated GatewayProvider, validates AI proposals against a safe-action allowlist, bounds retries, and routes follow-ups memory-first to AI or human review.

desktop-agent/src/ai-center-assist.ts.overview: AI Center routed-assistance pipeline (M6) that picks provider candidates via the router, calls models with sanitized diagnostic prompts, validates proposals, records usage/cost/activity, pushes RTDB signals, and degrades to operator review on budget blocks or outages.

desktop-agent/src/ai-center-routes.ts.overview: Engine HTTP route handler for /api/v1/ai-center: serves the provider catalog, provider key/prefs/test/model-discovery actions, routing config, usage summaries and activity, gated on operator sign-in and never returning key material.

desktop-agent/src/ai-center-store.ts.overview: File-backed AI Center local state: per-task routing config (ai-routing.json), an append-only activity ledger with restart recovery (ai-activity.jsonl), and a capped pending-sync queue (ai-pending-sync.json).

desktop-agent/src/ai-firebase.ts.overview: Best-effort Firebase Realtime Database notifier that pushes minimal sync signals (type, time, opaque ref) to other operator PCs, failing open when unconfigured and flagging sensitive values that must never be sent.

desktop-agent/src/ai-memory-cache.ts.overview: Engine-local mirror of server-approved AI recovery procedures and recent execution events stored in ai-memory.json, with TTL staleness checks, approved-only lookup, upsert, event capping and 24h pruning.

desktop-agent/src/ai-memory-panel.ts.overview: Shapes the local AI memory cache into the HTML-escaped dashboard payload for GET /api/v1/ai-memory and provides a local kill-switch that disables a cached procedure.

desktop-agent/src/ai-provider-store.ts.overview: AI Center provider credential and preference store: DPAPI/OS-store encrypted API keys in ai-providers.json (fail-closed without encryption) and separate per-provider prefs with last success/error tracking.

desktop-agent/src/ai-providers.ts.overview: Versioned catalog of six LLM providers plus direct-HTTPS adapters (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic messages, Gemini generateContent) with typed error classification, timeouts, bounded retries, fallback, model discovery, structured output, and cost estimation.

desktop-agent/src/ai-routing.ts.overview: Pure AI Center model-routing logic: task kinds and labels, default and normalized per-task routes, and a cost-aware decideRoute that respects manual pins, key health, monthly budgets and escalation.

desktop-agent/src/ai-sdk-bridge.ts.overview: Vercel AI SDK Core bridge that builds @ai-sdk/openai, anthropic or google models from stored provider credentials and runs generateText, used for SDK-mode Test Connection verification.

desktop-agent/src/ai-usage-store.ts.overview: Durable append-only AI usage ledger (ai-usage.jsonl) recording provider-reported tokens, latency and cost with pricing provenance, plus aggregation by provider/model/task and current-month spend.

desktop-agent/src/html-escape.ts.overview: Pure escaping helpers for engine- and shell-rendered HTML: entity escaping for text/attributes and inline-script-safe JSON literals that cannot close a script element.

desktop-agent/src/paths.ts.overview: Engine state path helpers resolving the AGENT_DATA_DIR root (or a home-folder default), creating it owner-only, and writing secret files with 0700/0600 permissions tightened on every call.

server/admin-config.ts.overview: Admin service for the logistics partner reference data: lists partners with their aliases and tracking domains, adds partners, aliases and domains, and switches them on or off. Every change is audited through writeAudit and nothing is ever deleted.

server/catalog-image.ts.overview: Express handler that serves catalog product images already stored in product_master, skus or sku_catalog, fetching them from marketplace CDNs with small-size hints and caching them on local disk. Guards against private/loopback hosts and oversized or non-image responses.

server/dates.ts.overview: Date helpers that normalize marketplace report date columns (ISO, day-month-name, M/D/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY) to YYYY-MM-DD, and compute IST calendar days and Unix-second day windows for OMSGuru daily pulls.

server/import-profiles.ts.overview: Declarative header-map profiles for each marketplace return report layout (Myntra, Flipkart, Meesho, Ajio, Amazon): required and optional headers, header aliases and lifecycle date columns, matched by normalized header text rather than column position.

server/lifecycle.ts.overview: Counts return lifecycle stages per day from stored upload rows, reading column names from each marketplace's LifecycleConfig and dates through parseReportDate.

server/logistics.ts.overview: Loads the per-marketplace logistics partner index (partners, aliases, tracking domains) from the database and applies the pure detectPartner rule to parsed upload rows idempotently. Also exports the shared Queryable type satisfied by pg Pool and PoolClient.

server/oms/catalog.ts.overview: Stores OMSGuru channel listings on each daily run into oms_listings (full records including the mapped OMSGuru master SKU) and sku_catalog (one title and image per normalized listing SKU), paging through listings with the last_id cursor.

server/oms/client.ts.overview: OMSGuru API client: environment-based configuration, rate-limit pacing via X-OMS-Remaining, throttle and 5xx retry with backoff, response-envelope parsing, and normalization helpers for listing SKU, title, image, id and money fields.

server/oms/invoices.ts.overview: Daily OMSGuru invoice pull for one IST day, paged by last_id: normalizes tracking numbers, builds stable invoice keys and upserts redacted invoice rows, plus oms_sync_runs bookkeeping through startRun and finishRun.

server/oms/master-bridge.ts.overview: Nightly bridge from synced OMSGuru listings to product_master, run in one transaction: inserts new mappings, fills blank images, and flips resolved unmapped listing SKUs. Channels that do not map to exactly one account (for example anything Myntra) are skipped and counted.

server/oms/orders.ts.overview: Normalizes OMSGuru order-detail response rows, strips buyer personal data before storage, and stores order snapshots and lookup outcomes (NOT_FOUND or error) so repeated runs skip them.

server/oms/skus.ts.overview: Syncs the OMSGuru master SKU list into oms_skus, paging with the last_id cursor and reporting stored versus newly inserted SKUs.

server/product-master.ts.overview: Core product master service: candidate-aware unmapped listing SKU resolution, audited merge or replace loads, image inheritance across listings of one product SKU, unmapped SKU queue reporting and CSV template, staged 500-row batch imports, and nightly auto-resolution through OMSGuru and VMS.

server/scripts/audit-deep.ts.overview: Ad-hoc audit script that parses local Amazon and Meesho sample return files and prints blank reverse-tracking statistics, return-type and status counts, and tracking-link host to carrier breakdowns.

server/scripts/audit-files.ts.overview: CLI audit script that parses each marketplace's sample return file and prints the upload preview counts, activation blockers, confirmations needed, and sample invalid, pending and warning rows.

server/scripts/diagnose-file.ts.overview: Read-only CLI diagnostic that runs a real marketplace file through inspectLayout and parseSpreadsheet and prints the same counts and warning samples an upload preview would show, without touching the database.

server/scripts/fetch-oms-orders.ts.overview: CLI that fetches OMSGuru order details for return rows already stored in the app (sub_order_id first, then order_id), saves snapshots, records misses, optionally writes a CSV report, and stops on a throttled answer.

server/scripts/inspect-layout.ts.overview: CLI that checks a marketplace export against its header profile with inspectLayout, printing the detected profile, normalized headers, missing required headers and a masked first data row. Nothing is written to the database.

server/scripts/load-product-master.ts.overview: CLI that loads the VB EXPORT product master workbook into product_master, replacing the table in one transaction while inheriting blank image links from rows of the same product SKU and reporting SKU conflicts.

server/scripts/report-returns.ts.overview: CLI script (npm run report:returns) that prints a daily return report straight from the database: latest marketplace upload lifecycle counts, receipt scans per IST day, OMSGuru invoice dispatches and an AWB cross-check, optionally writing CSV files to exports.

server/scripts/sync-oms-catalog.ts.overview: Daily OMSGuru catalogue sync script (npm run sync:oms) that pulls channel listings and the master SKU list into oms_listings, oms_skus and sku_catalog, then runs the product-master bridge, logging each step in oms_sync_runs.

server/scripts/sync-oms-daily.ts.overview: Daily OMSGuru invoice pull script (npm run oms:daily) that stores dispatched shipments with AWBs for every channel one IST day at a time, for yesterday, one date or an inclusive range, stopping cleanly when throttled.

server/scripts/sync-vms-catalog.ts.overview: CLI script (npm run sync:vms-catalog) that reads the external VMS catalogue strictly read-only and merges listing-to-master SKU mappings and blank image links into the local product_master, with help, CA pinning, probe, dry-run and apply modes.

server/tests/data-capture.test.ts.overview: Synthetic node:test suite for data-capture helpers: IST report-date parsing, lifecycle stage counting, OMSGuru invoice tracking normalization and keys, and preservation of raw uploaded row data.

server/tests/import.test.ts.overview: Large synthetic test suite for the return-report parser in sheets.ts covering Myntra, Ajio, Amazon, Meesho and Flipkart layouts, seller checks, identifier trust rules, repeat classification and product master parsing.

server/tests/marketplace-rules.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for marketplace-rules: account ranking, header and return-type normalization, SKU variation handling, tracking link parsing, 15-digit AWB rounding resolution and courier partner detection.

server/tests/oms-master-bridge.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for marketplaceForChannel, checking whole-word, case-insensitive channel-to-account mapping and null for ambiguous Myntra labels.

server/tests/oms-orders.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for OMSGuru order helpers: order row normalization, personal-data redaction and usable lookup key extraction.

server/tests/oms.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for the OMSGuru client and catalogue/SKU record builders: response envelopes, SKU/image normalization, throttle detection, credit-based waiting and request shapes with a fake fetch.

server/tests/product-master-batch.test.t.overview: Tests for batched product master import helpers: 500-row batch limit, batch slicing and progress, staged import ownership/TTL checks and blank-image inheritance.

server/tests/spreadsheet-numbers.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests building in-memory XLSX/CSV workbooks to check how sheets.ts treats long numeric identifiers: over-15-digit numbers blanked or made pending, scientific text refused and Meesho AWBs recovered from tracking links.

server/tests/unmapped-candidates.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for unmapped listing SKU resolution, checking article-suffix parents, spaceless variants, case-insensitivity and account scoping via listingSkuCandidates and unmappedIsResolved.

server/tests/upload-policy.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for upload activation rules: partial activation, fatal/no-access/empty-file blockers, pending rows, confirmations for untrusted identifiers or tracking disagreements, and duplicate counting.

server/tests/vms-catalog.test.ts.overview: Synthetic tests for the VMS catalogue integration: image/SKU cleaning, read-only SQL allowlist, TLS no-verify refusal, dedup rules, SQL chunk builders, fail-closed probe, category inference and SKU suffix stripping.

server/vms/catalog.ts.overview: VMS catalogue inspection and merge-only sync into product_master: reads listings, SKU images and photos from the external VMS database through the read-only guard, cleans and dedupes them, builds parameterized SQL chunks, and backfills canonical master SKUs into the return register.

server/vms/db.ts.overview: Connection layer for the external VMS PostgreSQL database: verified-TLS pool settings, a pinned CA fetcher, a connectivity check and queryVmsReadOnly, which allows only single SELECT/WITH statements inside a READ ONLY transaction.

desktop-agent/follow-up-window.test.ts.overview: node:test suite for the engine-side follow-up gate: checks that FOLLOWUP_NIGHTLY_ONLY defaults to check-whenever-due and parses off-values, that cycles are skipped outside the IST window only when nightly-only is opted in, and that nightlyWindowStatus reports the next window for the dashboard.

desktop-agent/src/follow-up-window.ts.overview: Engine-side gate for ticket follow-up cycles: reads the FOLLOWUP_NIGHTLY_ONLY opt-in (default is check-whenever-due), decides whether a cycle may lease a ticket given the shared 01:00-02:00 Asia/Kolkata window, and builds a window-status snapshot for the dashboard.

server/nightly-window.ts.overview: Pure, dependency-free time math for the Asia/Kolkata 01:00-02:00 claim-tracking window and the 48-hour post-submission eligibility rule; the Express server (reschedule path) and the desktop engine (lease gate) import this same file so the window cannot drift between them.

server/tests/nightly-window.test.ts.overview: Pure node:test checks for the nightly tracking window, using fixed instants: window constants, IST wall-clock conversion, [01:00, 02:00) boundaries, 48h eligibility anchored on submission time, next-window calculation, and 48h candidate alignment.

.dockerignore.overview: Docker build-context exclusion list that keeps VCS metadata, docs and Markdown, node_modules, build outputs, the Android project, environment and credential files (except the example templates), logs and PEM certificates out of every image built from the repository root.

docker-compose.yml.overview: Single-service Compose file that builds the root Dockerfile into the Return-App container, publishes port 3001 on loopback for a reverse proxy, loads .env plus optional mail, Firebase and payment-database overrides, mounts data/ and read-only certs/, sets the IST timezone and a 384 MB heap, and health-checks /api/health.

deploy/engine/docker-compose.yml.overview: Compose deployment for one automation-engine instance: builds deploy/engine/Dockerfile from the repository root, interpolates ENGINE_PORT for the loopback-only published port and the health check, persists browser profiles, evidence cache and logs in the engine-data volume, raises /dev/shm to 512 MB for Chromium, and rotates JSON logs.

.github/workflows/deploy.yml.overview: Production deploy workflow on push to main (ignoring android/, docs/ and Markdown): re-runs typecheck, build, tests and a docker build, then, only when the Hostinger SSH secrets are configured, writes the runtime env file and CA certificates from repository secrets, tars the source, uploads it with retrying ssh/scp and runs .github/scripts/deploy-remote.sh on the VPS.

.github/workflows/return-scan-apk.yml.overview: Android APK pipeline for android/** changes: sets up JDK 21 and SDK 34, runs Gradle unit tests and lint, decodes the release keystore, assembles an R8-shrunk release APK, verifies the package ID, a version code of at least 10000, the camera permission, the signature and a 10 MB size ceiling, then on push publishes a v1.0.<run> GitHub release and keeps only the newest two Android releases.

RUN.bat.overview: Windows double-click launcher for local development: checks Node.js, runs npm install on first use, warns when the environment file is absent, opens the web app in the browser after a short delay, and runs npm run dev (Vite web plus the tsx-watched API).

START-BOT.bat.overview: Windows launcher for the 24/7 marketplace claim desktop bot: verifies Node.js and packages, then runs npm run desktop inside a supervisor loop that restarts the Electron app after a crash and exits cleanly on a normal close.

index.html.overview: Vite HTML shell for the Youthnic Returns web console: declares PWA metadata (favicons, web manifest, theme colour, mobile web-app tags) and mounts the React app into #root by loading /src/main.tsx as an ES module.

install-desktop-app.bat.overview: Script-based installer for the 24/7 claim bot: checks for Node.js, runs npm install, creates a Desktop shortcut pointing at START-BOT.bat via a PowerShell WScript.Shell call, then launches the bot.

tsconfig.desktop.json.overview: Strict no-emit TypeScript configuration for the Electron shell (desktop/) and automation engine (desktop-agent/), targeting ES2022 with Node types and bundler resolution while excluding the separately configured desktop/renderer.

tsconfig.json.overview: Strict no-emit TypeScript configuration for the React web console in src/ and vite.config.ts, with DOM libs, react-jsx, bundler module resolution and Vite client types.

tsconfig.server.json.overview: Strict no-emit TypeScript configuration for the Express API in server/, using Node types, ES2022 target, esModuleInterop and JSON module imports.

android/CHANGELOG.md.overview: Changelog for the native Android scanner: an Unreleased (2026-10-13) entry fixing a scanner crash, mismatches with the /api/scan JSON contract, scan-key cleaning, sheet and dialog counting, and torch/camera bugs, and adding the sign-in camera permission flow, a multi-match picker and a units-affected stepper; plus the 1.0.1 native release feature list.

android/README.md.overview: Overview of the native Kotlin return scanner (shop.youthnic.returnscan): tech stack (CameraX, unbundled ML Kit, ViewBinding, EncryptedSharedPreferences), permission rationale, the scan state machine, the audio/flash/vibration feedback-signal table, local Gradle test/lint/release commands, the APK size budget and release-workflow notes.

android/build.gradle.overview: Root Gradle build script that declares the Android Gradle Plugin 8.4.2, Kotlin Android 1.9.24 and Google Services 4.4.2 plugins without applying them, and registers a clean task.

android/gradle.properties.overview: Gradle properties that give the build JVM a 2 GB heap with UTF-8 encoding, enable AndroidX, Jetifier and non-transitive R classes, and select the official Kotlin code style.

android/gradlew.bat.overview: Standard Gradle wrapper launcher for Windows: finds java.exe through JAVA_HOME or PATH, runs GradleWrapperMain from gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar with the default and user JVM options, and propagates the exit code.

android/settings.gradle.overview: Gradle settings that declare plugin and dependency repositories (Google with group filters, Maven Central, Gradle Plugin Portal), forbid project-level repositories, name the root project ReturnScan and include the :app module.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/bg_log.overview: Shape drawable for the app-mark tile on the sign-in screens: a 22dp rounded rectangle filled with the brand launcher-background green behind the white scan mark. No layout or Kotlin reference to it was found in the current source.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/bg_mar.overview: Shape drawable for the thin channel colour bar: a 3dp-radius white rectangle that layouts tint with each marketplace channel's colour.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/bg_pil.overview: Fully rounded (100dp radius) white pill shape used as the background for chips and badges; it is coloured with backgroundTint so the rounded corners survive, and is also applied through a theme style.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/bg_rou.overview: White rounded-rectangle (10dp radius) card background shared by the login, scanner, claim-capture and verification screens and their item cards.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/bg_she.overview: Small 2dp-radius drag-handle bar for bottom sheets and dialogs, filled with the shared border colour.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_add.overview: 24dp vector plus icon used as the increment control for received quantity on verification product rows.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_arr.overview: 24dp vector back-arrow icon for the toolbar navigation button on the scanner, channel, claim capture, barcode capture and settings screens.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_bar.overview: 24dp grey vector barcode-scanner icon on the claim capture screen, marking fields that can be filled by scanning a barcode.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_cam.overview: 24dp white two-path vector camera icon for photo and video evidence capture buttons on the scanner and claim screens.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_che.overview: 24dp vector right-chevron icon indicating a tappable row or forward action on login, claim capture and channel cards.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_clo.overview: 24dp vector close (X) icon for dismissing the image viewer, recent-scans dialog, evidence cards and the return verification sheet.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_con.overview: 24dp grey vector copy icon for the one-tap copy-to-clipboard control on the claim capture screen.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_dow.overview: 24dp vector download icon used for the app-update action on the channel screen and as the small icon of the in-app updater's download notification.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_his.overview: 24dp vector history icon on the scanner screen that opens the recent scans list.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_inf.overview: 24dp white vector info icon for the info button in the claim capture screen's header bar.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_key.overview: 24dp vector keyboard icon on the scanner screen for switching to manual AWB entry.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_lau.overview: 108dp adaptive-icon foreground vector: three white paths forming the scan mark, translated and scaled inside a group, used by the adaptive launcher icons and the splash drawable.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_pen.overview: 24dp vector icon named for pending items, drawn as a bulleted-list glyph (three rows of dots and lines); no layout or Kotlin reference to it was found in the current source.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_ref.overview: 24dp vector refresh icon for the reload action on the channel selection screen.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_rem.overview: 24dp vector minus icon used as the decrement control for received quantity on verification product rows.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_set.overview: 24dp Material gear vector icon in slate, used for the settings buttons on the marketplace (channel) and scanner screens.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_sig.overview: 24dp white warning-triangle vector icon for the CHECK scan verdict; no layout or Kotlin source in the app references it directly.
24dp white stacked-copy vector icon for the DUPLICATE scan verdict; no layout or Kotlin source in the app references it directly.
24dp white circular vector icon for the NOT FOUND scan verdict; no layout or Kotlin source in the app references it directly.
24dp white circular vector icon for the OK scan verdict, used as the default image in the scanner's last-scan banner and in the signal legend row.
24dp white circular vector icon for the STOP scan verdict; no layout or Kotlin source in the app references it directly.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_tor.overview: 24dp flashlight vector icon in slate for the torch toggle on the scanner and barcode-capture screens.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/splash.overview: Layer-list launch-screen drawable: the ic_launcher_background brand green with a centred 216dp ic_launcher_foreground scan mark; it is the window background of Theme.ReturnScan.Splash and replaces Capacitor's default splash.

android/app/src/main/res/drawable/viewfi.overview: Rounded-rectangle shape drawable with a 2dp viewfinder_reticle (emerald) stroke and a translucent white fill that frames the camera scan area on the scanner and barcode-capture screens.

server/schema-shopify.sql.overview: Shopify ingestion migration adding Shopify order, return and customer columns to expected_returns and a shopify_sync_runs log for real-time return and RTO syncs.

server/schema-unmapped-skus.sql.overview: Registry of marketplace listing SKUs that lack a product master mapping, plus indexes for case-insensitive product master lookups and unresolved return lines.

server/schema-vms.sql.overview: VMS catalogue sync run log recording each unattended daily sync from the read-only VMS source into the local product_master.

public/manifest.json.overview: PWA web app manifest for the Youthnic Returns console: standalone portrait display, brand background and theme colors, and maskable 192/512 PNG plus SVG icons.

scripts/vps-postgres-backup.js.overview: VPS backup job that dumps the production PostgreSQL database with pg_dump piped through gzip, uploads the archive to Google Drive in resumable 10MB chunks using a service-account JWT, prunes older Drive backups beyond the retention count, and deletes the local dump.

scripts/vps-watchdog.sh.overview: Per-minute Bash watchdog for the production VPS that checks the Docker container state and health, the internal and public /api/health endpoints, keeps a state file for alert throttling, restarts the container on failure, and sends WhatsApp alerts on outage, recovery or failed self-heal.

server/scripts/understand-dashboard.ts.overview: Small launcher that spawns the locally installed Understand-Anything viewer for the current working directory, passing CLI arguments through and mirroring its exit code.

server/seed.ts.overview: Empty placeholder module left after the demo seed was removed; nothing imports it and its comment says it should be deleted.

server/tests/sentry.test.ts.overview: Unit tests for the Sentry integration that check that the @sentry/node SDK exposes the required functions, captures a synthetic SYN- error with an event id, and attaches the Express error handler without crashing.

src/features.css.overview: Web-console stylesheet for newer features (live sync badge, scan result banner and counters, Iron tracking and return analytics), kept separate so the original index.css screens stay unchanged.

src/index.css.overview: Main stylesheet for the React web console: Tailwind import, brand color tokens on :root, and styles for login, the scan station, the DD/MM/YYYY date field, the register, claim details modals, the warehouse dashboard, the product master, marketplace accounts, analytics panels and responsive scan controls.

src/vite-env.d.ts.overview: Triple-slash reference that brings Vite client types (import.meta.env and asset imports) into the web console TypeScript project.

vite.config.ts.overview: Vite config for the React web console: React and Tailwind plugins, a dev server on 0.0.0.0:5173, and a proxy that sends /api (including the /api/live WebSocket) to the Express API port.
